title: Pictures folder
whyItMatters: Photos of family, ID documents and screenshots live here. Images often still carry GPS tags and camera details that the file listing itself does not show.
source: XDG user directories defaults (xdg-user-dirs creates Pictures under the home directory): https://www.freedesktop.org/wiki/Software/xdg-user-dirs/
notes: The folder name comes from ~/.config/user-dirs.dirs and can be localised or renamed, which this rule does not detect. Many desktops save screenshots to Pictures/Screenshots.
